title: Arcana Core Field Manual
summary: Understand Aether Signal, shared Arcana records, and safe cross-addon foundations.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Arcana Core is the shared foundation for the magic branch. It names Aether Signal, resonance, curses, relics, rituals, spells, and the provider contracts other Arcana addons build on.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Start by treating magic as signal science. Read Aether Signal state, keep contamination visible, and let each optional addon register data through Arcana Core instead of hardcoding another addon.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Discover an arcane signal, record the definition, expose it through Index or Grimoire, then let gameplay addons act on the same spell, ritual, curse, or relic record.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Aether services, definition registries, runtime bridge providers, and MissionCore hooks keep the Arcana Division coherent while still allowing optional addons to stay optional.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Arcane Index reads Arcana records, Grimoire explains them, Lens and HoloMap can inspect field context, and Veilbound bridges can report live pressure through optional providers.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a magic record is missing, check whether the provider addon loaded, whether the Arcana Core service was registered, and whether the consuming surface is using the shared identifier.
